A man in West Bengal beheaded his wife, severed her head and carried it to a local temple where he sat with the head before being arrested.

He told police he had become 'psycho' after the killing, neighbours reported marital discord that preceded the double murder of his wife and father, and officers later recovered the severed head from the temple. He was taken into custody after the incident.

He carried the severed head through the neighbourhood before reaching the temple. The double murder involved the death of his father. He was taken into custody by police.
